---
title: "ADFR documentation"
---

AutoDockFR (ADFR) is an open-source program for
[docking](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Docking_(molecular)) flexible ligands into receptors with
selective flexibility. It is distributed as part of the [ADFR software suite](download.qmd) and
built from [reusable software components](#implementation).

## Step-by-step tutorials

| Tutorial | |
|---|---|
| [Hello docking! Re-docking a ligand](tutorial-redocking.qmd) | CDK2 (PDB 4EK3) with a ligand from PDB 4EK4 |
| [Docking with flexible receptor side chains](tutorial-flexible-receptor.qmd) | the same complex, with 2 flexible side chains |
| [Docking a covalently bound ligand](tutorial-covalent.qmd) | PDB 3C9W |

**Before you start:**

- [Download and install ADFRsuite 1.0](download.qmd).
- Put `ADFRsuite-1.0/bin` on your `PATH` (Linux or macOS shell).
- Download and unzip the [tutorial data](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/agfr/download/551/)
  (`ADFRsuite-1.0_tutorial_data.zip`).

## FAQ

### How to create a PDBQT file for a rigid receptor

This creates a PDBQT file for a rigid receptor from a PDB file. The PDBQT file can be used as input
for AGFR, ADFR and ADCP, and for AutoDock4 and AutoDock Vina.

For docking ligands it is usually better to use the biologically active molecule (the biological
assembly), which is sometimes different from the asymmetric unit in a PDB file. Download the
biological assembly from the [PDB website](https://www.rcsb.org) ("Download Files" menu on the page
of the entry), or build it from the header information of the PDB file. For this example we
searched the PDB for 4EK3 and downloaded the biological assembly, saved as `4ek3.pdb1` in our
download folder.

Next, add hydrogen atoms. `prepare_receptor` can add hydrogens with OpenBabel, but we found that
[reduce from the Richardson lab](https://github.com/rlabduke/reduce) tends to give better results.
`reduce` is included in ADFRsuite. Run it from the command line:

```bash
$ADFRsuite_INSTALL_DIR/bin/reduce ~/Download/4ek3.pdb1 > 4ek3H.pdb
```

::: {.callout-tip}
On Windows, the `ADFRSuite/bin` folder is added to the path automatically, so you can type
`reduce` directly in a Windows command prompt (Start menu, type `cmd`).
:::

Then generate the PDBQT file with `prepare_receptor`:

```bash
$ADFRsuite_INSTALL_DIR/bin/prepare_receptor -r 4ek3H.pdb -o 4ek3.pdbqt
```

You now have a PDBQT file for your receptor.

## Implementation

The ADFR suite provides software tools for automated docking and related tasks. They are written in
Python, C++ and C, following a reusable-component philosophy.

To avoid mismatched Python packages, ADFRsuite ships a self-contained Python interpreter that is
isolated from the default Python on your computer (except for Windows installations). Start it with
the `pythonsh` script in `$WHERE_YOU_INSTALLED/ADFRsuite-1.0/bin/`. This folder also contains the
other executables of the suite.

### Packages developed, extended or wrapped by us

Located in `$WHERE_YOU_INSTALLED/ADFRsuite-1.0/CCSBpckgs/`.

| Package | Language(s) | Functionality | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| ADFR | Python | Ligand docking | |
| ADFRcc | C++ | AutoDock4 scoring function, Flexibility Tree, Solis Wets local search | |
| AppFramework | Python | Base class for writing applications | |
| AutoDockTools | Python | Legacy package used by `prepare_ligand` and `prepare_receptor` | |
| AutoSite | Python | Binding pocket identification | |
| bhtree | C | Spatial hashing | |
| DejaVu2 | Python | OpenGL 3D viewer with Qt camera widget | |
| geomutils | Python / C++ | Geometry utility functions | |
| gle | C++ | OpenGL extrusion library wrapper for Python | |
| mglkey | Python | Software key validation | |
| mglutil | Python | Utilities | |
| MolKit | Python | Legacy package used by `prepare_ligand` and `prepare_receptor` | |
| MolKit2 | Python | Read, write and query molecules | ProDy, Open Babel |
| mslib | C | Python wrapper of the MSMS library for computing molecular surfaces | |
| opengltk | C | Python wrapper of the OpenGL library | |
| PmvApp | Python | Generic molecular visualization application | |
| prody | Python | CCSB version of the ProDy package | |
| PyBabel | Python | Legacy package used by `prepare_ligand` and `prepare_receptor` | |
| pyglf | C | Python wrapper for OpenGL fonts | |
| Support | Python | | |
| UTpackages | C++ | Fast iso-contouring and volume rendering | |
| Volume | Python | Support for 3D rectilinear data grids | |

|---|---|---|

| IPython | Improved Python shell | 2.2.0 |
| matplotlib | 2D plotting | 1.2.0 |
| mmtf | Compressed PDB format | |
| nlopt | Nonlinear optimization | 2.5.0 |
| numpy | Numeric arrays extension | 1.9.2 |

| PySide | Python wrapper for Qt 4.8 | 1.2.2 |
